title: The Maharashtra Merged Territories (Janjira and Bhor) Khoti Tenure Abolition Act.
full_text: The Maharashtra Merged Territories (Janjira and Bhor) Khoti Tenure Abolition Act. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195371 Act Number: 71 Enactment Date: 1953-12-28 Act Year: 1953 Short Title: The Maharashtra Merged Territories (Janjira and Bhor) Khoti Tenure Abolition Act. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Revenue & Forest Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1. SCHEDULE Order Appendix Forms TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Maharashtra Merged Territories (Janjira and Bhor) Khoti Tenure Abolition Act. Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Abolition of khoti tenure. Section 3A. Abolition of Khoti tenure in Karle village in the merged territories of Janjira in Kolaba district. Section 4. Who shall be occupants in merged territories of Janjira. Section 5. Who shall be occupants in merged territories of Bhor. Section 6. Certain tenants to be occupants. Section 7. Liability to pay khot’s dues and rights of khot extinguished. Section 8. Commutation of khot’s dues. Section 9. Occupancy price or commuted value recoverable as arrear of land revenue. Section 10. Khot to hand over accounts, etc., to authorised officers. Section 11. Uncultivated and waste lands and all property of nature specified in section 37 of Code vest in State Government. Section 12. Extinction of khot’s right of reversion. Section 13. Right to trees. Section 14. Method of compensation for extinguishment or modification of any rights and interests in land. Section 15. Limitation. Section 16. Court-fees. Section 16A. Revisional Powers in respect of awards made before commencement of Bom. XCIII of 1958. Section 17. Inquiries and proceedings to be judicial proceedings. Section 18. Amount of compensation to be payable in transferable bonds. Section 19. Provisions of Bom. LXVII of 1948 to govern relations of khot and tenants. Section 20. Act not to apply to Kauli lands. Section 21. Rules. Section 22. Repeal. Schedule 1.
